Description 150-160 characters. Write it as the pitch you want shown, because

/.title: Synthetix™ — Governed Agentic AI for Enterprise Delivery
/.description: Specialist AI agents run discovery, architecture, build and verification as one governed pipeline — with policy gates and human oversight throughout.

/platform/.title: The Command Layer for Your Enterprise Estate | Synthetix

/why-synthetix/.description: Copilots augment individuals. Synthetix runs governed agentic execution across your whole estate — with workflow awareness, evidence trails and accountability.

/company/.title: Buy the Hands, Keep Control | About Synthetix
/company/.description: Enterprise delivery does not need faster typists. It needs AI agents that own the work, stay inside governed boundaries, and answer for every action they take.

/contact/.title: Contact Synthetix — Let's Get Specific
/contact/.description: Tell us what you are building, modernizing or trying to fix, and we will show you exactly how Synthetix solves it. Request a demo or start a walkthrough.
